title: Go Liboor
description: A mobile travel discovery app prototype designed to help travelers find destinations that match their interests. The design focuses on clean navigation, intuitive interactions, and interest-based filtering.

title: Inventory Management App (External)
description: A UI/UX prototype designed for PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional to improve warehouse coordination. The design addresses operational inefficiencies by digitizing approval processes and logistics tracking.

title: Info Berkoh
description: A community-based information system for Kelurahan Berkoh that provides demographic information, public services, local news, complaint reporting, and visual documentation. The project combines user interface design with frontend implementation using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: SoalPedia
description: An educational question bank interface designed to support learning and assessment. The interface uses a structured layout to make different question types easier to categorize, browse, and retrieve.

title: Nucifero
description: A web UI project for flower bouquet customization and ordering. The design is optimized for mobile use with a clean product catalog, intuitive customization flow, and easy checkout experience.

title: Flutix App
description: A mobile cinema ticket booking application designed to help users book movie tickets without waiting in line. The user flow covers movie discovery, film selection, ticket booking, and electronic payment.

title: Sistem Informasi Open Recruitment Kepanitiaan (SIREK) BEM Unsoed Berbasis Web
description: A web-based open recruitment system for BEM Unsoed designed to streamline committee recruitment through event information, registration forms, recruitment announcements, and an administrative dashboard. The system was developed using Laravel, Inertia.js, Vue.js, and MySQL.

title: Sistem Informasi Open Recruitment Kepanitiaan (SIREK) BEM Unsoed Berbasis Mobile
description: A mobile-based open recruitment information system for BEM Unsoed designed to make committee recruitment and event information more accessible to students. The application focuses on improving recruitment efficiency, information dissemination, and student participation through a mobile platform.

title: Sistem Informasi Open Recruitment Kepanitiaan (SIREK) BEM Unsoed UI/UX Design
description: A UI/UX design project for SIREK BEM Unsoed focused on designing an intuitive and accessible open recruitment experience. The design covers the user flow from discovering events and viewing event details to completing registration and checking recruitment announcements.

title: Disney Website
description: A website concept dedicated to Disney movies. Users can explore movie selections and view detailed information including movie synopses and character lists.

title: Barterin
description: A mobile application designed to facilitate cashless item exchanges in a safe and practical way. Developed using the Design Thinking approach, the concept focuses on interest matching, chat, user ratings, and location recommendations to support a user-centered exchange experience.

title: BarTani
description: An AI and AR-based mobile application designed to help farmers identify plant pests and diseases. The UI/UX design focuses on making agricultural technology easier to understand through an intuitive mobile experience.

title: GoldenActivities
description: A web-based platform designed to support social and physical activities for older adults. Developed for the Soedirman Technoporia 2024 Web Development Competition, the platform provides activity information, achievements, health articles, user profiles, and an admin panel.

title: Plant Society
description: A responsive e-commerce website for ornamental plants developed using WordPress and WooCommerce. The platform provides product browsing, wishlist, shopping cart, checkout, customer dashboard, educational blog content, and an admin management system.

title: SosmedCare
description: A web-based expert system designed to help users assess their level of social media addiction. The application provides an interactive questionnaire, diagnosis results, recommendations, and an admin panel for managing symptoms, questions, solutions, and diagnostic rules.

title: Outsourcing Recruitment System
description: A web-based recruitment platform developed for PT Mitra Daksa Anarawata to streamline outsourcing recruitment. The system includes multi-role authentication, job management, applicant profiles, application tracking, interview scheduling, candidate ranking using the SAW method, dashboards, and automated CV generation.

title: EduHub – Learning Management System
description: A modern full-stack online learning platform built with Laravel 11, Vue 3, Inertia.js, and Tailwind CSS. Features interactive course exploration, structured curriculum modules, video player, server-evaluated quizzes, and cryptographically verifiable digital certificates.

title: PooPals – Couple Wellness Partner
description: A private couple wellness web application built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase. Features bowel movement tracking with the clinical Bristol Stool Scale, daily hydration logging, mood/energy vibe tracking, physical activity rings, couple streaks, cheer reactions, and granular privacy controls.

title: Finora – Personal Finance Management
description: A modern personal finance SaaS application built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase. Designed to help users track income and expense transactions, manage monthly category budgets, set savings goals, and visualize cashflow trends with interactive Recharts analytics and dark/light mode.
